name: @group-ui/group-ui
description: A web component library for the Volkswagen Group and Brands

scripts.start:no-watch: npm run generate-themes-css && stencil build --dev && npx serve www -p 3333 --no-request-logging -c local-server-config.json
scripts.build: npm run generate-themes-css && stencil build -c stencil.release.config.ts --docs --es5
scripts.build:showcase: npm run generate-themes-css && stencil build -c stencil.showcase.config.ts --es5
scripts.build:complete: npm run generate-themes-css && stencil build -c stencil.complete.config.ts --es5
scripts.build:local: npm version prerelease --git-tag-version false && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.test: npm run checkstyle && npm run test:unit
scripts.playwright:screenshot: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui -w /groupui mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chrome-desktop-screenshots --project=firefox-screenshots --project=safari-screenshots ./components/$npm_config_component"
scripts.playwright:screenshot:update: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui -w /groupui mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chrome-desktop-screenshots --project=firefox-screenshots --project=safari-screenshots ./components/$npm_config_component -u changed"
scripts.playwright:smoke:update: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui -w /groupui mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chrome-screenshots-smoke-test --project=firefox-screenshots-smoke-test --project=safari-screenshots-smoke-test ./components/$npm_config_component -u changed"
scripts.playwright:behaviour: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui -w /groupui mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chromium-behaviour --project=firefox-behaviour --project=safari-behaviour ./components/$npm_config_component"
scripts.playwright:a11y: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui -w /groupui mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chromium-a11y --project=firefox-a11y --project=safari-a11y ./components/$npm_config_component"
scripts.check-empty-index: if ! grep -q '<body></body>' src/index.html; then echo 'Error: index.html body is not empty'; exit 1; fi
scripts.checkstyle: npm run prettier && npm run stylelint && npm run lint
scripts.checkstyle:fix: npm run prettier:write && npm run stylelint:fix && npm run lint:fix
scripts.generate-themes-css: npm run convert-scss-to-css && npm run copy-themes-assets && npm run copy-tokens
